questions.prompt: How does the proposed mileage support change after 10,000 business miles?
options: The tax-free rate rises from 25 to 35 pence per mile.
The tax-free rate stays at 55 pence for all further miles.
Drivers receive a fixed £194 payment for the remaining miles.
Only nurses can claim support beyond that distance.
questions.explanationZh: 前10000英里55便士，之后由25便士升至35便士；不同数字不可混用。

questions.prompt: Why is the proposed allowance rule contrasted with a cliff edge?
options: It delays the assessment of extra earnings until the next financial year.
It lowers support progressively instead of removing it all at the threshold.
It raises the earnings threshold but retains the loss of the full allowance.
It replaces a weekly assessment of earnings with a two-week payment.
questions.explanationZh: 每多赚1镑扣1镑是逐步减少，区别于刚超限就全额丧失。

questions.prompt: Which statement matches the parcel-box timetable?
options: All 1,000 boxes were available when the announcement appeared.
The first 500 boxes will arrive after all branch upgrades finish.
The target is 500 by the end of 2026 and 1,000 by the financial year’s end.
The target is 600 boxes by 2026 and 500 branches in the next year.
questions.explanationZh: 500和1000是两个时间点的投递箱目标；600是升级网点数量。

questions.prompt: Why would the same headline saving not describe every household’s experience?
options: The measures begin together but offer larger payments to drivers.
The savings depend on households using several services in sequence.
The package gives priority to families applying before Christmas.
The support works differently and depends on who meets its conditions.
questions.explanationZh: 公务用车、符合条件的家长等适用条件不同，且机制不同；不能把潜在节省额当人人相同结果。

questions.prompt: Which summary best connects the examples in the article?
options: The package combines financial-rule changes with improvements to everyday services.
The package mainly replaces public services with direct cash payments.
The package makes all family support depend on earnings above a single limit.
The package combines already measured savings from one shared tax change.
questions.explanationZh: 文章比较里程税费、育儿与照护补助、关税和包裹服务，非单一机制或已测得统一成效。
